unit.why: The division holds a complete footnote tale: the Maggid of Kozienice's prayer recovers two barrels of gold stolen from a prince's shipment. After it comes the closing lines of story (מ) from the previous division.
unit.boundary_note: after the footnote, the text from 'בקערת כסף אחת' to the end continues story (מ) begun in the previous division (the silver bowl from the barren woman)

stories.start_quote: ואלה אזכרה שסיפר לי הרב ר׳ נחמי'
stories.summary_en: When two barrels of gold coins vanish in transit from Paris, a prince travels with his Jewish partner R. Shlomo to the Maggid of Kozienice; his prayer sows a quarrel between the thieves and the carters, who come to him to settle it, and he persuades them to return the gold.
